scripts.build: vp run --cache desktop#build && cd apps/desktop && electron-builder -c build.json
scripts.build:win32: vp run --cache desktop#build && cd apps/desktop && electron-builder -c build.json --win --ia32
scripts.build:win64: vp run --cache desktop#build && cd apps/desktop && electron-builder -c build.json --win --x64
scripts.build:mac: vp run --cache desktop#build && cd apps/desktop && electron-builder -c build.json --mac
scripts.build:dir: vp run --cache desktop#build && cd apps/desktop && electron-builder -c build.json --dir
